"""A six-statement run repeated back-to-back: period == window size.

The two windows that carry one segment hash are ADJACENT (the second starts
on the line after the first ends), so ``merge_overlapping_items`` folds them
into one span too -- adjacency and overlap are separate merge branches, and
a stage carrying only one of them would leave the other unproven.
"""


def adjacent_host(base: int) -> int:
    seed = base * 2
    limit = seed + 3
    scale = limit - 1
    step = scale + 4
    acc = step + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values = [acc]
    values.append(acc + 2)
    total = sum(values)
    label = str(total)
    acc = step + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values = [acc]
    values.append(acc + 2)
    total = sum(values)
    label = str(total)
    return len(label)
